summary: This bill directs the Bureau of Prisons to maintain a photographic directory of all federal prisoners, ensuring each photograph shows an uncovered and unobstructed view of the prisoner's face.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates the Bureau of Prisons to maintain a photographic directory of federal prisoners. This directly relates to the administration and record-keeping within the criminal justice system, specifically concerning incarcerated individuals, which leans towards stricter justice and stronger policing by enhancing identification and record maintenance.
